faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Dachshund?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 16-32 lb (7-14.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Dachshund?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD); Obesity-related spinal stress; Dental disease. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Dachshund at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Dachshund, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
